title: Python For TypeScript And JavaScript Engineers
summary: Refresh senior Python fundamentals through the similarities, differences, and production traps most relevant to TypeScript and JavaScript engineers.
audience: TypeScript and JavaScript engineers who need a senior-level Python refresh for production work.

units.title: Runtime Model
units.summary: Review Python names, objects, mutability, truthiness, exceptions, data model hooks, and imports.

units.title: Types And Contracts
units.summary: Use gradual typing, Any, protocols, dataclasses, and runtime validation without importing TypeScript assumptions.

units.title: Packaging And Environments
units.summary: Understand pyproject.toml, virtual environments, dependency groups, import names, lockfiles, and deployment pain points.

units.title: Async Testing And Production
units.summary: Review asyncio, blocking work, test boundaries, style standards, and production maintainability.
